item.title: [−1] FIIs net sell Rs 1,149 crore-worth Indian equities, lowest outflow of October; DIIs net buy Rs 3201 crore
item.description:
Signal: foreign investor selling. 7 reports from TradingView, GujaratSamachar English, Moneycontrol.com and 4 more. Related: “Sitharaman flags $33 billion FPI outflows as Indian stock markets fall nearly 12% this year”. Ongoing: also reported on 5 of the previous 7 days (first 13 Oct).

Banks & NBFCs: mild headwind (−1) — Foreign selling hits large lenders

Why it matters: Foreign portfolio outflows weigh on Indian equities, especially large lenders and index heavyweights, and pressure the rupee.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows −3, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1, Rupee −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] RBI injects Rs 1 lakh crore as liquidity tightens before festive season
item.description:
Signal: RBI tightening (India). 9 reports from The Economic Times, TradingView, CNBC TV18 and 4 more. Related: “RBI tightens scrutiny of $1 billion-plus overseas investments amid rupee pressure”. New in the last 24 hours.

Banks & NBFCs: mild tailwind (+1) — Lending margins widen at first

Why it matters: A higher repo rate lifts loan rates for homes, vehicles and businesses and pushes up bond yields, though it supports the rupee and lenders' margins at first.

Market gauges: Bond market (G-Secs) −3, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1, Growth outlook −1, Rupee +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] Gold inches up on softer dollar as investors assess Fed rate outlook
item.description:
Signal: higher gold prices. 16 reports from Trade Brains, Reuters, FXStreet and 12 more. Related: “Gold, silver futures rise as global cues improve and Fed rate hike concerns ease”. Mixed: 14 reports point the other way. New in the last 24 hours.

Banks & NBFCs: mild tailwind (+1) — Gold-loan collateral worth more

Why it matters: India is one of the largest gold importers, so dearer gold widens the trade deficit and cools jewellery demand, while lifting gold-loan collateral values.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
